name: Chili Cheese Dog Combo
note: Blondie's (Toon Lagoon) Chili Dog Combo $18.79: 'Foot long hot dog topped with chili cheese sauce and diced onions' + fries (platter includes fries; combo adds fountain drink, excluded here since zero-carb choices exist). Basis: Sonic Footlong Chili Cheese Coney published panel (830 cal/66g carb/51g fat/24g protein/2100mg Na) + ~5oz theme-park fries (~450 cal/55g carb). Decomposition's 120g matches; keyword 63g missed the fries.

name: Rapunzel Sundae
note: DFB/WDWNT reviews confirm components: shortcake base + lemon DOLE Whip + wild berry soft-serve swirl, berry compote, sugar flowers, whipped cream ($7.79 snack cup). Basis: ~1 cup soft serve (Dole Whip official 90 cal/22g carb per 1/2 cup → ~44g) + shortcake ~26g + compote ~15g + sugar flowers ~10g. Top of model range (68-95g) is correct; this is sugar-dense.

name: Indian-Style Bread Service (with all 9 accompaniments)
note: As sold = FIVE breads (traditional/garlic-ginger/spiced naan, onion kulcha, paneer paratha) + 9 dip ramekins; reviews call it 'almost a meal in itself' for 2-4. Basis: 5 x ~75-90g naan-class breads (~40-47g carb each per USDA/takeaway naan data) ~195-230g + 9 x ~2 tbsp chutneys/jams/hummus ~55-60g carb. Models' 120-160g treated it as a single-bread serving — systematic undercount.

name: All Classic Dozen
note: Sum of Voodoo's OFFICIAL per-doughnut nutrition (PDF effective 7/1/2025) over the published Classic Dozen composition (baker's dozen of 13, per Voodoo Toast ordering pages): Blueberry Cake, Buttermilk Bar, Glazed Old Fashioned, Raspberry Romeo, Sprinkle Cake, Powdered Sugar Cake, Plain Cake, Cinnamon Sugar Cake, Raised Glazed, Chocolate Ring, Chocolate Old Fashioned, Butterfingering, Maple Bar. Caloric math checks (4545 est vs 4500). Prior 45-53g was one doughnut, not the box.

name: Whole Cheese Pizza
note: Louie's Italian (USF) Whole Cheese Pizza $38.99 is a LARGE shared pie, not personal: reviewers state a 'jumbo slice' ($11.29) 'is honestly a quarter of a whole large pizza' → whole pie = 4 jumbo slices, ~16in. Basis: large-pizzeria cheese pie analog (Domino's 14in hand-tossed cheese whole = 2320 cal/272g carb, scaled x1.3 for 16in). Models' 70-96g was one jumbo slice, not the whole pie as sold.
